text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (January 28, 2025) for 130 Cosburn Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee – Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (January 28, 2025) for 130 Cosburn Avenue, Folder Number 25 108625 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to March 31, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
